The lead publishes the plan for review
Dependent tickets are armed with Start when ready
Three tickets start in parallel: Claude, Codex and a local model
A test job holds the tests slot while another waits
shop-42 asks a question: it shows as Needs you and in the Inbox
The review comes back with one finding
Alex reviews the plan and asks for changes
The fix lands; shop-41 signs the guestbook
#44 starts by itself now that #41 is done
